repairs.quote: Tryndamere spins through his enemies, dealing (80/120/160/200/240 + (100% bonus Attack Damage) + (80% Ability Power)) physical damage and generating 2 Fury per enemy hit, increased to 5 Fury against enemy champions. This Ability's Cooldown is reduced by 0.75 seconds when Tryndamere critically strikes, and reduced by 1.5 seconds when critically striking a champion.
